task_name: C3-H4: Employment in Washington clears screening
intent: Open with exactly: "I was fired after I reported a safety problem at work." When asked who this would be against, say exactly: "It's Evergreen Millwork." State is Washington. Date: June second, twenty twenty six. You need the new client packet by email: if they ask email or text, say email. Decline booking. Stay until they confirm the intake is on the file and the packet was sent. A spoken promise to take care of it without those writes is not enough. After they confirm the intake is on the file and the packet was sent, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." Do not book an evaluation. End the call.

parameters.summary: Retaliation after a workplace safety report.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.
The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone. NOT any other question.
The agent asks who the claim would be against, who the other side is, or who this would be against. NOT any other question.
The agent asks which state this happened in, or where it took place. NOT any other question.
The agent asks when the incident happened, or for the date of the accident, injury or event. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was June second, twenty twenty six.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human staff member, a live person at the front desk, or a real agent because they cannot continue on this line. NOT when transferring you to screening, intake, scheduling, or client services on this call. NOT when you already asked for a person.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks whether you want to book a case evaluation, a free evaluation, or an appointment. NOT when offering or sending the new client packet, and NOT when confirming intake is recorded.
scripted_responses.response_value: No thank you. I just need intake and the packet on file.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers the new client packet or asks whether to send it by email or text. NOT when asking to book a case evaluation.
scripted_responses.response_value: Please send the packet by email.

intakes.summary: Retaliation after a workplace safety report.
